notes: At most 2 agents build, review or fix at once (4 CPUs). A free slot goes, in order, to (1) a pending fix, (2) a pending review, (3) the next role whose depends_on roles are built, reviewed and fixed (PLAN-5 10.3). Waves are the default order.

Ownership: within one wave the 'owns' lists are disjoint (PLAN-5 appendix A checks it against git ls-files plus 'planned_new'). A path may be owned by roles of different waves; the later role starts only after the earlier one is reviewed and fixed, so the hand-off is sequential. Roles never edit 'shared_frozen' paths; a needed change goes through the orchestrator.

Milestone waits inside a wave: web-flood-overview imports flood types only after the commit 'brief 5 backend-flood-sources: M1 contracts' is in git log, and copies the web fixtures after '...: M2 fixture'. web-flood-forensic mounts the dock hydrograph after 'brief 5 web-flood-command: M1 hydrograph'. Web roles use backend/scripts/serve_fixture.py until the real routes they need are in git log (PLAN-5 7.2).

Commits: 'brief 5 <role>: M<n> <what>' with a pathspec (git add <own paths>; git commit -m "..." -- <own paths>), ending with the two attribution lines; push after each milestone (git push origin claude/cool-mayer-ki7to6; on rejection git pull --no-rebase origin claude/cool-mayer-ki7to6, then push; on index.lock wait 10 s and retry). Never force-push, never commit data/ or .env.

Each build role writes docs/redesign/progress/brief5-<role>.md, docs/redesign/reports/brief5-<role>.json (summary, files, screenshots, known_issues, cut_line_left), docs/redesign/contract5/<role>.md (as-built notes; only the integration edits CONTRACT.md) and docs/screenshots/brief5-<role>-*.png (view every one).

Reviews: one reviewer per build role, two lenses (design and contract fidelity; behaviour and safety), in a clean worktree, on ports 8757/5217 (8758/5218 when two reviews run at once), writing docs/redesign/reports/review5-<role>.json, docs/redesign/progress/review5-<role>.md and docs/screenshots/review5-<role>-*.png. The fixer owns the role's paths and its own ports and commits 'brief 5 <role>: review fixes'.

Gates for every role before its last commit: cd backend && uv run pytest -q; cd web && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build (lint 55 warnings, all in src/scene; add none). A gate failure confined to another role's file is recorded and rerun after that role's next commit.

Secrets: FIRMS_MAP_KEY and EARTHDATA_TOKEN only from the environment or .env; never printed, logged, committed or copied; leak scans are count-only. There is no EARTHDATA_TOKEN in the cloud session: the token path is tested with a fake token and a mock transport only.
Ports: never 8000, 8710, 5173, 5180. Stop every server you start. One Chrome at a time per agent; iterate with npx vitest run <files>.
Glob syntax: '*' stays inside one folder, '**' crosses folders, '[!x]' excludes a first character, '[Ff]' matches either case.
